products.name: Blender AI Add-ons
products.note: 3D creation AI plugins; open-source; local processing; model provenance varies by plugin

profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a non-profit, open-source foundation based around Blender, a free and open-source 3D creation suite. The software covers a broad range of production tasks including rendering, camera and object tracking, rigging, animation, visual effects, and 2D drawing directly in a 3D viewport. Blender is used, according to its site, in short films, advertisements, TV series, and feature films, and VFX professionals are quoted describing its tracking tools as "probably the best tracker in the market." The foundation is a member of ASWF, Khronos, Linux Foundation, and OIN, and the project receives hardware support from AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the site tracks Blender AI Add-ons as a product category, described as third-party 3D creation plugins that run locally and are open-source, with model provenance varying by individual plugin. Blender's own Python API and community add-on ecosystem form the broader framework through which these integrations are delivered. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the foundation.
